en.headline: Hong Kong exports surge 64.9 per cent in September, fastest in over 40 years
en.dek: The Census and Statistics Department said the value of total exports reached HK$762.6 billion, driven by AI-related electronics, marking the twentieth consecutive month of double-digit growth.
body: Hong Kong's total exports of goods rose 64.9 per cent year on year to HK$762.6 billion in September, the fastest monthly growth in more than four decades, the Census and Statistics Department said on Wednesday.

The increase followed a 53 per cent rise in August. Imports climbed 57.8 per cent to HK$808.9 billion, resulting in a visible trade deficit of HK$46.3 billion, or 5.7 per cent of import value. For the first nine months, exports were up 45.2 per cent and imports 45 per cent.

A government spokesman attributed the performance to sustained strong demand for AI-related electronic products. Exports of electrical machinery and parts rose 66.2 per cent, while office machines and automatic data processing equipment surged 183.7 per cent. Shipments to Asia increased 67.5 per cent, with particularly large gains to Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand and mainland China.

The spokesman said merchandise trade should continue to benefit from the wave of AI-related investment and resilient global growth, while cautioning about external uncertainties including geopolitical tensions and protectionist measures.

zh.headline: 香港9月出口按年升64.9% 創逾40年最快增速
zh.dek: 政府統計處公布，9月整體出口貨值達7626億元，受人工智能相關電子產品帶動，連續第20個月錄得雙位數增長。
body: 政府統計處周三發表數據顯示，本港9月商品整體出口貨值按年上升64.9%，至7626億元，創超過40年以來最快單月增速。
升幅較8月的53%擴大。進口貨值按年升57.8%至8089億元，錄得有形貿易逆差463億元，相當於進口貨值的5.7%。首九個月出口累計升45.2%，進口升45%。
政府發言人表示，表現受人工智能相關電子產品出口持續強勁帶動。電動機械及零件出口升66.2%，辦公室機器及自動資料處理儀器更升183.7%。輸往亞洲出口升67.5%，其中台灣、馬來西亞、泰國及內地升幅顯著。
發言人指，展望未來商品貿易將繼續受惠於人工智能相關投資熱潮及環球經濟韌性，但須密切關注中東衝突、保護主義措施等外圍不確定因素。
